item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Trojanettes lock up Division 2 title
item.description: The Nanticoke Area girls basketball team locked up the Wyoming Valley Conference Division 2 title Monday night. Kate Reed scored a game-high 19 points and Nevaeh Baran had 14 to lead Nanticoke Area to a 69-36 victory over Hanover Area at Nanticoke. Nanticoke Area is 12-1 in the division and will close out the regular season Wednesday against Holy Redeemer. It’s Nanticoke Area’s first division championship since 2017. item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Tyce Mason, Dallas basketball
item.description: Tyce Mason has the potential to lead the team in scoring on any given night. He also does a lot of the things that don’t always appear on a stat sheet. Whether it’s distributing the basketball to create shots for his teammates or taking the open look when he gets one, Mason’s confidence on the floor at both ends has helped the Mountaineers climb to the top of the Division 1 standings. item.title: Dominick Barlow’s career night leads 76ers past Clippers for fourth straight win
item.description: Tyrese Maxey scored 29 points, and Dominick Barlow added 26 points and 16 rebounds as the 76ers beat the Los Angeles Clippers 128-113 on Monday for their fourth straight victory.
